burn(address,address,uint256,uint256).details: Mock pool burn that reverts so that `divest` never suceeds, but `eject` does.

burnPoolTokens(address,uint256).details: Only the Strategy itself can call this function. It is external and exists so that the transfer is reverted if the burn also reverts.

returns.baseReceived: Amount of base tokens received from pool tokens
returns.fyTokenReceived: Amount of fyToken received from pool tokens

params.baseTo: Address to send any remaining base to.
params.fyTokenTo: Address to send the purchased fyToken to.

returns.returnedBase: Amount of base unused and returned.

claim(address).details: Claim all rewards from caller into a given address

returns.baseObtained: Amount of base tokens obtained from burning pool tokens

returns.baseReceived: Amount of base tokens received from pool tokens
returns.fyTokenReceived: Amount of fyToken received from pool tokens

firewall().details: 获取防火墙路由器地址

getRoleAdmin(bytes4).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes4,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

grantRoles(bytes4[],address).details: Grants all of `role` in `roles` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - For each `role` in `roles`, the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

init(address).details: Returns additional values to match the pool init function and allow for strategy migrations. It is expected that base has been transferred in, but no fyTokens

returns.baseIn: Amount of base tokens found in contract
returns.fyTokenIn: This is always returned as 0 since they aren't used
returns.minted: Amount of strategy tokens minted from base tokens which is the same as baseIn

returns.poolTokensObtained: Amount of pool tokens minted from base tokens

lockRole(bytes4).details: Sets LOCK as ``role``'s admin role. LOCK has no members, so this disables admin management of ``role``. Emits a {RoleAdminChanged} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: See {IERC2612-permit}. In cases where the free option is not a concern, deadline can simply be set to uint(-1), so it should be seen as an optional parameter

remit(address).details: Trigger a claim for any user

renounceRole(bytes4,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`.

returns.baseIn: Amount of base tokens used to restart

revokeRole(bytes4,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

revokeRoles(bytes4[],address).details: Revokes all of `role` in `roles` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - For each `role` in `roles`, the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

setFirewall(address).details: 公开设置防火墙地址（仅在未设置时可调用，支持动态更新）

setRoleAdmin(bytes4,bytes4).details: Sets `adminRole` as ``role``'s admin role. If ``role``'s admin role is not `adminRole` emits a {RoleAdminChanged} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - the caller must have a balance of at least `wad`.

version().details: Setting the version as a function so that it can be overriden

base().notice: Mock pool base - Must match that of the calling strategy

burn(address).notice: Burn strategy tokens to withdraw pool tokens. It can be called only when invested.The strategy tokens that the user burns need to have been transferred previously, using a batchable router.

burnDivested(address).notice: Burn strategy tokens to withdraw base tokens. It can be called when not invested and not ejected.The strategy tokens that the user burns need to have been transferred previously, using a batchable router.

burnPoolTokens(address,uint256).notice: Burn an amount of pool tokens.

buyFYToken(address,address).notice: Buy ejected fyToken in the strategy at face value

call(address,bytes).notice: If everything else goes wrong, use this to take corrective action

divest().notice: Divest out of a pool once it has matured

eject().notice: Divest out of a pool at any time. If possible the pool tokens will be burnt for base and fyToken, the latter of which must be sold to return the strategy to a functional state. If the pool token burn reverts, the pool tokens will be transferred to the caller as a last resort.The caller must take care of slippage when selling fyToken, if relevant.

fyToken().notice: Mock pool fyToken - Can be any address

init(address).notice: Mint the first strategy tokens, without investing

invest(address).notice: Start the strategy investments in the next poolWhen calling this function for the first pool, some underlying needs to be transferred to the strategy first, using a batchable router.

maturity().notice: Mock pool maturity - Can be set to a value far in the future to avoid `divest` calls

mint(address).notice: Mint strategy tokens with pool tokens. It can be called only when invested.The pool tokens that the user contributes need to have been transferred previously, using a batchable router.

mintDivested(address).notice: Mint strategy tokens with base tokens. It can be called only when not invested and not ejected.The base tokens that the user invests need to have been transferred previously, using a batchable router.

restart().notice: If we drained the strategy, we can recapitalize it with base to avoid a forced migration

setRewardsToken(address).notice: Careful, this can only be done once.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: if_succeeds {:msg "TransferFrom - decrease allowance"} msg.sender != src ==> old(_allowance[src][msg.sender]) >= wad;
